question: Should OpenClaw core adopt this gateway-local Teams identity, exact-resource authorization, and public `api.teams` Plugin SDK contract as the permanent multi-user sharing architecture?
rationale: The branch establishes durable security, storage, gateway role, protocol, and external plugin contracts whose ownership and long-term compatibility cannot be resolved by routine code repair.

options.title: Sponsor this architecture
options.body: Adopt the core Teams kernel and require the concrete fixes, full security review, migration proof, and real deployment evidence before merge.

options.title: Narrow to Workspaces
options.body: Keep exact-tab sharing owner-local to the bundled Workspaces plugin and defer a general-purpose core identity and Plugin SDK authorization contract.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer or close the implementation until maintainers select a smaller or different multi-user product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this architecture
recommendation.body: Adopt the core Teams kernel and require the concrete fixes, full security review, migration proof, and real deployment evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The Workspaces foundation and the adjacent plugin/core and gateway-role boundaries were established through their merged feature history.
